title: .LLab Alignment Quick-Check™
intro: A five-minute check on whether your day-to-day work still matches your stated priorities. This is a mirror, not a report card.

upsell.name: The .LLab Leadership Alignment Map™
upsell.copy: closes the gaps this quick-check surfaces.

nodes.label: Mission Clarity
nodes.prompt: Whether your mission is stated clearly enough to guide a decision.

nodes.label: Priority Fit
nodes.prompt: Whether today's priorities actually reflect that mission.

nodes.label: Resource Fit
nodes.prompt: Whether time, money, and attention go where the mission says they should.

nodes.label: Follow-Through
nodes.prompt: Whether commitments made against the mission actually get finished.

bands.copy: Alignment is loose right now. Start with whichever dimension scored lowest.
Partial alignment. Mission and action agree some of the time — find where they split.
Strong alignment. The Alignment Map™ below connects it to strategy and culture too.

closing.prompt: The dimension furthest out of alignment is, and the fix I'll try first is:
